result.summary: Found 1 visually broken element: the top-right header button/avatar renders as an empty blank circle, while the rest of the page layout, content, and navigation appear intact.

issues.description: The circular button/avatar in the top-right header appears empty and broken: it is a blank light-grey circle on a white background with only a small red dot visible and no icon or avatar image inside.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the intended avatar image or icon loads correctly, add a fallback icon/placeholder if the image fails, and increase the button's visual contrast so its purpose and tap target are clear.
